description: THRESHOLD screen: every US $10B+ name whose week moved 6%+ either way, sorted by size of move. A quiet week returns few rows or none, and that is the answer. For a ranked board of what is busiest, use get_hot_stocks.

include_history.description: Include each stock's ~22-session [unix_seconds, close] sparkline series. Default false.

min_market_cap.description: Minimum market cap in USD dollars. Default 2e10 ($20B); 1e10 ($10B) widens the net.

name: get_weekly_movers
